title: TX queue destroy: prevent retry after failed rollback restoration
description: Round-2 security review found that if frame_pool_destroy succeeds, pthread_mutex_destroy fails, and fallible frame_pool reinitialization also fails, the object retains a queue mutex but an invalid pool mutex; retry enters invalid synchronization. Remove reliance on fallible rollback or mark the object terminal and make every later queue/destroy operation reject without touching destroyed synchronization.
acceptance_criteria: Every tx_queue_destroy failure either leaves a fully retryable object or a clearly terminal object whose later public operations fail safely without locking destroyed state; failure-path tests cover the supported behavior; host sanitizer suite passes.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
